name: S2-COMPRESSED-ACT row 3 fixture 2: the pin rule discriminates
note: Section 1 of Emerald Hill beside section 1 of Chemical Plant. Chosen because the 75%-of-sections pin rule fires here (a two-section act pins any page both sections reference), so this act's worst-window count DEPENDS on how mark_pinned_pages reaches place_pool. The row-3 fixture s2_two_clip does not: its verdict is 12 whether the pin rule is wired correctly or not, which would have made the bake-vs-s2_clip_budget agreement unable to see the defect parcel 3 found. Correct wiring gives 10; the pre-2026-09-17 s2_clip_budget wiring gives 11 (reproduce with --pins raw).
